verses.text: God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.
lines: God, give the king your justice;
your righteousness to the royal son.

verses.text: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.
lines: He will judge your people with righteousness,
and your poor with justice.

verses.text: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.
lines: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people.
The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

verses.text: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.
lines: He will judge the poor of the people.
He will save the children of the needy,
and will break the oppressor in pieces.

verses.text: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.
lines: They shall fear you while the sun endures;
and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.

verses.text: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.
lines: He will come down like rain on the mown grass,
as showers that water the earth.

verses.text: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.
lines: In his days, the righteous shall flourish,
and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

verses.text: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.
lines: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea,
from the River to the ends of the earth.

verses.text: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.
lines: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him.
His enemies shall lick the dust.

verses.text: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
lines: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute.
The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

verses.text: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.
lines: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him.
All nations shall serve him.

verses.text: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.
lines: For he will deliver the needy when he cries;
the poor, who has no helper.

verses.text: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.
lines: He will have pity on the poor and needy.
He will save the souls of the needy.

verses.text: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.
lines: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence.
Their blood will be precious in his sight.

verses.text: They shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba. Men shall pray for him continually. They shall bless him all day long.
lines: They shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba.
Men shall pray for him continually.
They shall bless him all day long.

verses.text: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.
lines: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land.
Its fruit sways like Lebanon.
Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.

verses.text: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.
lines: His name endures forever.
His name continues as long as the sun.
Men shall be blessed by him.
All nations will call him blessed.

verses.text: Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
lines: Praise be to Yahweh God, the God of Israel,
who alone does marvelous deeds.

verses.text: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.
lines: Blessed be his glorious name forever!
Let the whole earth be filled with his glory!
Amen and amen.

verses.text: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.
